name: email-love
description: Official Email Love plugins for Claude: build export-ready emails in Figma from your design system

plugins.name: emaillove-figma-builder
plugins.description: Build export-ready marketing and lifecycle emails inside your Figma file from your Email Love design system, with a guided brief, visual component picker, and inspiration from 500,000+ real brand emails

plugins.name: emaillove-migration-audit
plugins.description: Read-only audit of an existing Figma design system for Email Love migration: classifies every template (live-text, editable-image, hybrid, not emailable), extracts brand foundations, estimates effort

plugins.name: emaillove-eds-converter
plugins.description: Convert an audited legacy Figma design system into a working Email Love design system: foundations, then modules in batches with design review between batches. Requires an emaillove-migration-audit report
